sentences.text: Artiodus belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, the group of cartilaginous fish.
It is classified within the parent group Euselachii.
The genus Artiodus is monotypic, containing only the single species Artiodus prominens.
The evolutionary affinities of Artiodus remain unclear, a common issue for many Paleozoic cartilaginous fish genera.
Fossils of Artiodus prominens have been found in the Early Permian deposits of the Middle Urals in Russia.
Artiodus lived during the Artinskian stage, between 290.1 and 283.3 million years ago.
